tagline.id: Skid proses ringkas untuk belajar instrumentasi dan kontrol proses secara langsung.
tagline.en: A compact process skid for hands-on learning of instrumentation and process control.

problem.id: Belajar kontrol proses biasanya hanya lewat teori dan simulasi, karena peralatan industri terlalu besar dan mahal untuk praktik.
problem.en: Process control is usually learned through theory and simulation only, because industrial equipment is too large and expensive for practice.

approach.id: Sistem proses skala kecil dirancang di atas skid mekanik, dilengkapi instrumentasi, panel kontrol, dan kontroler yang bisa diprogram.
approach.en: A small-scale process system built on a mechanical skid, with instrumentation, a control panel, and a programmable controller.
